name: Bitstack
long_description:
Bitstack is building a new neobank powered by crypto. Bitstack has gone from a simple product that turns your spare change into bitcoin to a bitcoin-native neobank that is bringing a better way to manage all things money, with better money. We believe getting started with Bitcoin should be simple, fun and accessible to everyone.

Bitcoin is an unparalleled financial alternative: a radically new way to transact and store value all around the world. It is a new kind of currency that isn't centrally controlled by any business, government or bank and that cannot be debased. Bitcoin will redefine the future of finance, from payments to savings, and wealth preservation. It is the first open and borderless monetary network with a fixed supply of 21 million, making bitcoin the most scarce financial asset ever.
one_liner: All things money, with better money

launches.title: Bitstack — the easiest way to save and invest in Bitcoin in Europe 🇪🇺
launches.tagline: Bitstack rounds up your daily purchases and invests the spare change in Bitcoin.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** Bitstack is the easiest way for people in Europe to get their first crypto wallet. Users can get started by rounding up their purchases and investing the spare change in bitcoin, and then use our app to buy, sell, earn and spend cryptocurrencies like bitcoin. We believe getting started with Bitcoin should be simple, fun and accessible to everyone.  **Download the app 👉** <https://bitstack-app.com/download>

Hi YC! We’re [@Alexandre Roubaud](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/710971) & [@Kabir Sethi](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/user/711533), the founders of Bitstack.

[**Bitstack**](https://bitstack-app.com/) **is the easiest way to save and invest in Bitcoin in Europe. 🇪🇺**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=64459&key=user_uploads/710971/48d95d1b-f5d5-43b3-93f0-89bd95091a38)

Bitstack is the easiest way for people in Europe to get their first crypto wallet. Users can get started by turning their spare change into bitcoin and then use the app to buy, sell, earn and spend new digital currencies like bitcoin.

Simply download the app, securely link your bank account and you’re all set. Bitstack will automatically round up your everyday purchases to the nearest euro and invest the spare change in Bitcoin.

There is no need to determine the right time to buy and no investment knowledge required.

### **Why should you save in Bitcoin?**

Today, 2 out of 3 people are worried about not achieving their financial goals, whether that’s buying a house, saving for retirement, a vacation, or their children’s future.

Unfortunately, most people continue saving in low-interest savings accounts that are consistently outpaced over the years by rising inflation.

But Bitcoin fixes this. Bitcoin is the first open, global and permissionless monetary network with a fixed supply of 21 million bitcoins, ever, and protected by a distributed network of users all around the world.

**So we built Bitstack to finally make it simple, fun and accessible for everyone to save and invest in Bitcoin.**

### **What our users say**

Since the launch of our Beta 3 months ago, we’ve already helped our users save **1.5+ billion satoshis**. Did you know? 1 Bitcoin = 100 million satoshis.

* “Bitstack is a fun way to build up savings and get started with Bitcoin!”
* “It’s the best app for me as I don’t know how to save.”
* “Very convenient to dollar-cost-average without having to think about it.”

### **How do I get started?**

**Download the app now 👉** <https://bitstack-app.com/download>

**Ask**: Give us feedback at [founders@bitstack-app.com](mailto:founders@bitstack-app.com) so we can make this product even better, and tell your family and friends in Europe to try us out!

Thanks! **🧡**

The Bitstack Team
